description:
WHAT: Static list of the official sanctions lists sanctions_screen_names checks (id, name, authority, download URL), the score scale and the legal disclaimer.
WHEN: To choose the lists parameter, cite sources in a report, or explain coverage before paying.
WHEN NOT: To screen a name (sanctions_screen_names, paid). It does not download lists or report freshness.
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One static object, including the disclaimer to show with screening results.
BEHAVIOR: No network calls; static local catalog, instant. No rate limits.
PARAMETERS: None: call with an empty object {}; the result is static and cannot be filtered. Its output feeds sanctions_screen_names: each sources[].id (OFAC_SDN, OFAC_CONS, EU, UK, UN) is a valid value for its lists parameter, and score_scale explains how its minScore threshold is applied.
EXAMPLE: {} -> {"sources":[{"id":"OFAC_SDN","authority":"US Treasury OFAC",...},...]}
name: sanctions_list_sources
title: List covered sanctions lists (free)
